solution: Each active call needs a stack frame, so deep recursion uses memory and may exceed the call-depth limit. Repeated calls add overhead, and a poorly chosen branching recurrence may repeat the same subproblems.

marking_points.criterion: Explains performance impact without claiming all recursion is exponential.
